input.summary: Both stair flights (spruce, with stringers, well rails), a loft ladder, every interior and exterior door (both halves), all windows (panes joined, sills, fanlight), and second-floor shutters are in. make.sh runs with no refused writes and no off-palette blocks. Walk reaches 14/14 rooms. The front render shows the windows, shutters and door correctly.
left: Loft ladder is at x15 z21 (y19..24), not plan's x16: x16 sits under the rear windows x16..17, which have no wall behind. The floor cell 15,23,21 was cut for it.
Roof part (still unticked) must keep the loft windows open: I glazed x11..12 y26..27 at z5 and z22 and they were air, no conflict seen.
Doors on the garden side have no step; the grounds part should lay path a / path c at the doors.
The ladder rises to y24 and the exit is the loft floor at z20. Rooms 14 (loft) was reached by walk, but its furnishing should keep x15 z20 clear.
The upper well's rail runs x7 z12..15 only. The south end z16 is open so the bathroom door x7 z17 stays reachable.
